EXT.evidence: Addresses the whole group and takes charge by asking for promises, then directly checks with one person—socially assertive behavior.

AGR.evidence: Promotes cooperation and harmony by asking everyone to promise to 'be good' and ensuring compliance.

CON.evidence: Sets and monitors expectations; secures promises from all and specifically verifies with one member, showing rule-focused thoroughness.

NEU.evidence: No signs of anxiety, distress, or irritability; interactions are calm and matter-of-fact.

OPN.evidence: No evidence of curiosity or imaginative thinking, nor of rigid dogmatism; actions focus on maintaining order.
